cohort: The study included 109 neonates with culture-proven Klebsiella infection in the NICU (patient group) and 417 neonates admitted to the same unit on the same day without Klebsiella infection (control group).
finding: Prior hospitalization, prematurity, and invasive procedures were identified as significant risk factors for Klebsiella infections in neonates, with CRKP infection correlating with higher mortality and previous antibiotic use.
